context.transcript:
Attention, Hibbin food shoppers.
Starting in April, our store will have a new policy.
We will no longer offer single-use plastic bags at the checkout counter.
You're welcome to bring your own bags.
However, we also have cloth tote bags available for purchase at the checkout counter.
And these are not your ordinary shopping bags.
What's special about them is that they're available in ten different colorful patterns that we're sure you'll love.
We've decided to offer these tote bags in response to the community's feedback.
You made your voices heard, and Hibbin Foods has listened.
context.transcript_translation:
请注意，Hibbin 食品购物者们。
从四月开始，我们的店将有新的政策。
我们在收银台将不再提供一次性塑料袋。
欢迎您自带购物袋。
不过，我们也在收银台出售布制手提袋。
而且这些可不是普通的购物袋。
它们特别之处在于，它们有十种不同的彩色图案供您选择，我们确信您会喜欢。
我们决定提供这些手提袋是为了回应社区的反馈。
你们让自己的声音被听到了，Hibbin Foods 也听到了。
